claude.sample_unit: cases (12 per disease, each run under male and female prompts)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy change under prompt variation (male vs female physician persona)
links.effect: Female prompt gave numerically higher VL accuracy in all four models (8.3–16.7 points gain); no between-prompt differences statistically significant (all p>0.05).
links.quote: No between-prompt differences reached statistical significance (all p>0.05).

links.outcome: Change in diagnostic accuracy when physician persona gender varied in prompts
links.effect: Numerical trend favoring female prompt (VL gains 8.3–16.7 pp; CD gains 16.7 pp in LLaMA 3 and Mixtral); ChatGPT-4o 100% both conditions; no significant differences (all p>0.05).
links.quote: No between-prompt differences reached statistical significance (all p>0.05).

unlisted_practices: Prompt standardization regarding physician persona gender

links.effect: Female prompt improved VL accuracy by 8.3–16.7 percentage points across all models; CD LLaMA 3 70B and Mixtral 8x7B improved by 16.7 points; all p>0.05.
links.quote: The gender assigned to the physician persona produced subtle, nonsignificant variations in LLM diagnostic accuracy, with a consistent numerical trend favoring the female prompt in open-weight models.

links.effect: For CD, ChatGPT-4o was 100% under both conditions; LLaMA 3 70B and Mixtral 8x7B improved 16.7 points; Meditron-70B remained 16.7%.
links.quote: For CD, ChatGPT-4o achieved 100% under both conditions; LLaMA 3 70B and Mixtral 8x7B improved by 16.7 percentage points with the female prompt, while Meditron-70B remained at 16.7%.

links.effect: Prompt gender changes yielded VL gains of 8.3–16.7 points and CD gains of 16.7 points in two models, but no significant between-prompt differences.
links.quote: For VL, the female prompt yielded numerically higher accuracy in all four models (gains of 8.3–16.7 percentage points), with ChatGPT-4o reaching 91.7%.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate diagnostic LLMs for sensitivity to physician-persona gender in prompts.
